summary: Verified the pricing/gating change: gpt-4o-mini and gemini are FREE, only nvidia is Pro-gated. All 5 scenarios pass. Free user can select gemini (dropdown value becomes 'gemini', no Stripe tab) and gpt-4o-mini. Selecting nvidia as free opens https://buy.stripe.com/test_28E5kFdwa68k6Ni4Du0Fi00 in a new tab and reverts the dropdown to previous (gpt-4o-mini). Free gemini-2.5-pro audit populates all 3 columns (architect/chaos/hardened) end-to-end. GPT-4o-mini regression audit also populates all 3 columns. Pro tier (?pro=true) shows pro-badge, hides go-pro-button, drops the '· Pro' suffix from nvidia option, and allows selecting nvidia without Stripe tab. Option labels: gpt-4o-mini (plain), gemini-2.5-pro (plain), nvidia-nemotron-super · Pro (only nvidia has Pro suffix for free users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Free-tier gating change works. PREMIUM_MODELS=['nvidia'] only. Free user select gemini => actually sets model, no Stripe tab. Nvidia free select => opens Stripe test buy URL and reverts dropdown. Pro tier via localStorage or ?pro=true unlocks all. gemini-2.5-pro audit is slow (~40-60s across 3 stages) but completed within 75s waits.
